newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one week rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one week rates fall.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a quiet private sector market on Wednesday to 6-1/2 and 7-1/2 percent from Tuesday's range of 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent, two bankers said.
One week rates were also 6-1/2 and 7-1/2 percent, compared to seven and 7-1/2 percent on Tuesday.
Few bankers performed deals in the quiet, long market before the start of the Moslem holiday of Eid al-Adha April 17-19.
The public sector retained its lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
